content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

A sovereign digital commerce stack is not just a collection of tools, it's a self-contained infrastructure that lets you collect payments, store orders, and deliver products without relying on any external platform. This means you own your data, your customers, and your revenue streams - no more being locked out by Stripe or Gumroad's 10% fees. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, that's a $921 difference in fees alone. With COREMERCH, you can sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software without being held back by platform restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

COREMERCH's architecture is built on a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your digital store, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets store your orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver your products. NOWPayments handles automatic crypto payment processing, with 300+ cryptocurrencies supported and a 0.5% fee. The beauty of this architecture is that each component is interchangeable and upgradable, giving you control over your infrastructure and the freedom to scale.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH is designed for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. This includes countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines. If you're a creator who's been locked out by these platforms or wants to avoid their fees, COREMERCH is the solution you've been looking for.
COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack gives you control over your data, customers, and revenue streams, no platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of COREMERCH's architecture include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments is the payment processor, with automatic crypto payment verification and a 0.5% fee. Each component is carefully selected for its reliability, scalability, and ease of use, ensuring that your commerce stack is fast, secure, and efficient.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with COREMERCH, you'll need to purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. This will give you everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Once you have the kit, follow these steps: deploy your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages store, set up your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, and configure your Supabase or Google Sheets order storage. With these steps, you'll be up and running in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question a reader would ask is: 'How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?' The answer is simple: use COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack, which includes automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. With this stack, you can sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software without relying on any external platform.
